channel.title: DoubleCheck Legal
channel.description: Data and analysis on AI in legal work, document drafting, and attorney review — from DoubleCheck Legal.

item.title: How to Use AI for Your Business: The Rise of Agentic Law for Entrepreneurs and Lawyers
item.description: Learn how agentic AI is changing legal work for entrepreneurs and lawyers — from understanding legal issues and finding the right attorney to drafting, document review, research, and workflow automation.

item.title: How Small Businesses Can Use AI for Legal Work: 3 Rules for Better Results
item.description: Learn how small businesses can use AI for legal work more effectively. Choose the right AI model, reduce hallucination risk, and know when important documents need human review.

item.title: How to Use AI for Legal Documents: 7 Things to Know Before You Draft
item.description: What to check before you rely on an AI-drafted contract, NDA, or legal letter — citations, confidentiality, model choice, and when to bring in an attorney.

item.title: New Data: Businesses draft legal documents with AI and seek professional review
item.description: A new survey of 304 startup workers and business developers reveals how they use AI to produce legal documents and seek professional verification.

item.title: What California SB 574 Can Mean for AI-Native Law Firms
item.description: SB 574 ties the attorney confidentiality duty to who can reach an AI input, not how long a vendor retains it — what that means for AI-native firms, and four questions to ask any AI vendor before January 1.

item.title: How to Incorporate a Company in the U.S.: A Founder's Simple Playbook
item.description: A step-by-step playbook for incorporating a U.S. company: choosing a structure, picking a state, filing, and the documents that matter after formation.

item.title: Jev for Lawyers: How AI Decision Models and OpenAI's Decisions API Can Improve Boutique Law Firm Workflows
item.description: How Jev and OpenAI's Decisions API can help independent attorneys and boutique law firms build more reliable AI workflows for document review, drafting, triage, and quality control — without replacing the lawyer or the generative AI doing the writing.

item.title: Welcome to the DoubleCheck Legal Blog
item.description: Insights on AI-generated legal documents, attorney review, and the future of legal verification.
